name: Garry Crum
line: Marine Corps and Rhode Island Air National Guard · Iraq. Took the gavel when the Post was a week from closing, and led the rebuild of the hall and the membership.

name: Bernie Brennan
line: Marine Corps Reserve, 2002–2013 · Iraq, twice, with 2/24. Runs the Post's website and membership drive. Thinking about joining? Ask for Bernie.

name: Eddie Myers
line: U.S. Army infantry, 2007–2012 · Iraq, twice. One of the people a newcomer can ask for at the door.

name: James Burnham
line: U.S. Army · Iraq and Afghanistan. Looks after the Post's finances and records.

name: Micholas Credle
line: Retired U.S. Army captain · more than ten years' service, including West Point. Keeps the Post's correspondence and minutes.

headline: Last *Wednesday* of every month.
line: 6 p.m. in the hall. Prospective members are welcome — come in and ask for an officer.

headline: Auxiliary meeting, last *Thursday* of the month.
line: 6:30 p.m. Family of those who served overseas are eligible to join the Auxiliary.
cta: Scan to learn about the Auxiliary

headline: Sunday *football*, every Sunday.
line: Canteen open noon to 9 p.m. with the day's NFL games on, from the 1:00 kickoffs through the night game.
cta: Scan for this week's games and menu

headline: Teams of four. Three rounds. One *winner*.
line: Hosted by Logiq & Kobi D., music by DJ Rukiz. Doors 7, trivia at 8. Free to play. Ten weeks, with a $500 finale.

headline: A seat at the *table*.
line: Three-course, family-style dinners at the Post by Chef Kimberly Andrade. Night in New Orleans, Nov 5 · Mexican Mercado, Dec 3 · Italian Trattoria, Dec 10. 6:30 p.m., $35, 21+.

headline: Around the world in *8 dates*.
line: Culinary speed dating at the Post: eight 10-minute dates over six tasting courses. Thursday Oct 29 and Thursday Dec 17, 6:30 p.m. Limited to 8 women and 8 men, 21+, $75.

headline: Back to the *'80s*.
line: Costumes encouraged. Music, contests and prizes, inside the Post. Hosted by Jessica and Marissa.

headline: Wings, *fourteen* ways.
note: Eight pieces $12 · wings and fries $15 · served with ranch or blue cheese. Please tell your server about any food allergies.

headline: The hall is yours to book.
line: Birthdays, showers, repasts, meetings, watch parties — up to 90 guests. Call the Post and press 2, or see vfw4651.org/event-spaces.html
